title: The Work page leads with merges an hour and says how long an item takes from release to merge, and warns when the pipeline stalls
description: The real control plane's /api/status reads the merges of the last 24 hours, release-to-merge time over the last 10 merges, the last merge and the open item released longest ago from the ledger. A real browser on the built dashboard at 390 and 1280 px leads with one figure, first and largest: merges an hour over the last 24 hours with the count in brackets. Under it one calm line gives the time since the last merge and the median release-to-merge time, with no ids; when the last merge is over three times the median old, or an item has run past the slowest tenth, the sentence becomes a warning naming that item's key, title and stage with one next action. No page scrolls sideways and the top bar's counts keep their meaning.
